elements.element: Vendor indemnity subject to a 3× annual fees super-cap
elements.evidence: No super-cap language; 21.3 merely lists "indemnification obligations" as Excluded Claims

reasons: All atomic elements of the preferred position are present in the inserted Section 20: Vendor defence and indemnity for Customer and Affiliates, the four required trigger categories (IP infringement of Services/Deliverables, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incident, gross negligence/wilful misconduct), the notice/control/cooperation procedure, and a Customer indemnity confined to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.

The fallback bargain is not satisfied (no modification/combination/specification exclusions, no procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, no 3× super-cap), but that is irrelevant since the locked preferred level is complete and the levels are not mixed.

Minimality holds: the Agreement had no indemnity clause, and the insertion is a concise three-paragraph provision with no hold-harmless boilerplate, no extra indemnitees, no Customer defence duty and no settlement mechanics beyond notice, control and cooperation.

Intent preserved: Sections 9.3, 19.5 and 21.3 are untouched and their assumed indemnity now exists. Note (non-blocking) that Section 9.3's cross-reference to "the remedies required by Section 20.5" remains unresolved because no infringement-remedy subsection was added; a short procure/modify/replace/refund insert at 20.4/20.5 would cure the pre-existing dangling reference.
